main_text.p: idque propter opus suum; ac Eosdem à contumeliofo prophanorum hominum contemptu asserere, ac vindicare. Quùm enim Euangelizantium pedes non modo speRom.10.15.ciosi sint, sed & adeo minabundi, ut vel Matth.10.14.ijs excussus puluis ad iudicium, & vindicam apud Deum valeat; eorum certè preces ad gloriam tuam temporalem in hac vita stabiliendam, & ad coelestem in futura impetrandam haud dubiè valebunt. Quam utramque Pietati T. ex animo humillimè à Deo Opt. Max. precatur

page.notes: The first word "idque" carries a mark over the q as printed; read as idque. The line-end "Eosdem" is followed by a catch-mark; the word is taken as whole. The Google watermark at the lower right is excluded as digitiser's mark. No page number is printed. The "ELEN-" catchword is the start of the next gathering's first word.
